engines.comment: The build scripts are .mts run by node directly, which needs the type stripping that became unflagged in 22.18.

scripts.setup: npm run clean && npm install && npm run cv:tex && node scripts/build-cv-pdf.mts --optional && node scripts/publish-cv-pdf.mts --optional && node scripts/build-cv-images.mts --optional
scripts.dev:open: (until curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000; do sleep 0.5; done; open http://localhost:3000) & next dev
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes serve@latest out
scripts.cv:pdf: npm run cv:tex && node scripts/build-cv-pdf.mts && node scripts/publish-cv-pdf.mts && node scripts/build-cv-images.mts
